The Final Leg of each season sees the last three or four teams race to the finish line, where the team who comes in first is the "Official Winner" of the race. 
There are only three teams who run the Final Leg called the Final Three, besides Seasons 25 and 26 which each had four teams.

unnamed_4: *NOTE: There have never been Speed Bumps, Fast Forwards, or any other types of challenges on the Final Leg. Seasons 35 and 37 featured a Scramble of Route Info and Road Block challenges.
